item: Using GitHub Copilot allowed me to complete the test generation tasks more quickly.
Using GitHub Copilot helped me achieve better test quality.
Overall, I found GitHub Copilot to be a useful assistant for this unit testing task.
In practice, Copilot accurately captured the intended business logic and test oracles of the code under test.
The test cases generated by Copilot were mostly executable and correct without requiring major manual modifications.
Copilot frequently generated "hallucinated" assertions or hidden logic errors that cost me a lot of time to debug.
I was able to write effective comments or prompts to successfully guide Copilot in generating the tests I wanted.
I was able to accurately identify flaws or invalid assertions in the Copilot-generated tests.
I was able to effectively adapt my testing workflow to collaborate with Copilot (e.g., managing code context, and iteratively refining suggestions)
(1) I was able to create tests that meaningfully verified the behavior of the target code.
(2) I believe the tests I produced would be useful for future debugging, regression testing, or code modification activities.
(3) The amount of effort required to write tests manually felt reasonable compared to the quality of the resulting tests.
(4) I am confident that the assertions in my tests correctly verify the intended behavior of the system.
(5) I believe my tests would be capable of detecting incorrect behavior or future regressions in the target code.
(6) During the task, I rarely felt uncertain about whether my tests were correct.
(7) I was confident in my ability to design test cases that appropriately covered the target code.
(8) I felt capable of debugging failing tests and identifying the causes of failures.
(9) After completing the task, I feel confident in handling similar testing tasks in the future.
